requirements.label: The system must accept any story input and understand it completely.
The system must understand characters as complete psychological entities, not name tags.
The system must maintain perfect continuity across the entire narrative.
The system must support natural, emotionally engaging conversation with AI creative roles and characters.
The system must support the full spectrum of human involvement.
The system must apply creative style and taste.
The system must support rapid iterative generation — the core creative loop.
The system must produce professional-grade production artifacts.
The system must export to professional formats with embedded narrative intelligence.
The system must show a playable assembly at every stage.
The system must show production readiness per scene.
Every AI decision must be explainable and overridable.
The system must learn from user choices.
Nothing is ever lost. No decision is final.
Changes propagate intelligently through the dependency graph.
The system must accept real-world production assets as first-class inputs at any point in the workflow.
The system must support multi-human collaboration.

sections.title: Phase Summary
lines: - **Phase 0 — Foundation** (001–002): Project scaffolding and pipeline infrastructure. Artifact store with immutability, snapshot versioning, dependency graph, audit metadata, cost tracking hooks, and structural validation.
- **Phase 1 — MVP Pipeline** (003–007): First working pipeline: script in -> canonical script + scenes + project config out. End-to-end smoke test.
- **Phase 2 — World Building** (008–011): Folder-based bibles (characters, locations, props), entity relationship graph, continuity state tracking.
- **Phase 2.5 — UI** (011b–011c): Production-quality Operator Console and resource-oriented routing. Research-driven design, then build. Foundation for later UI surfaces.
- **Phase 3 — Timeline** (012–013): Timeline data artifact with scene/story ordering, stacked tracks, and always-playable rule.
- **Phase 4 — Role System** (014–019): Role hierarchy, Director + Canon Guardians, style pack loading, suggestion/decision lifecycle, inter-role communication, and human interaction modes.
- **Phase 5 — Creative Direction** (020–023, 093–097, 099–100): Intent-first director's vision model, concern groups, and scene workspace.
- **Phase 6 — Shot Planning & Visualization** (025–027, 137, 143, 144): Coverage strategy, storyboards, animatics, keyframes, and AI-previz.
- **Phase 7 — Generation** (028–030, 140): Render adapter, user asset injection, generated-output QA, and media validation.
- **Phase 8 — Cross-Cutting Polish** (031–034): Semantic impact assessment, cost dashboards and budget caps, memory model, and in-app style pack creator.
